## What you did
* You prepared the production PostgreSQL 17 cutover via RDS blue/green deployments, ensuring the read replica follows the deployment without replacement [1].
* You rehearsed the cutover on a clone, measuring 74 seconds of write downtime, and identified the need for a dedicated rollback rehearsal [1].
* You opened PR #321 with the infrastructure changes and runbook [1].

## What changed
* Maya moved the cutover window to Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC to avoid Fernhill's month-end batch, and authorized merging the PR [8].
* Daniel will cover the API on-call during the switchover [7].
* Lior confirmed ingest workers need no configuration changes, just a 30-minute notice to pause consumers [9].

## What is still open
* Update the runbook with the new window and merge PR #321 [8].
* Rehearse the rollback procedure on a fresh clone this Thursday to measure downtime and data loss [1].
* Notify Daniel and Lior 30 minutes before the Sunday switchover [7][9].
